description: The physical shape a modelled entity takes in a deposition. This is a structural fact from the source, never an interpretation of what the entity is for — that is ligand_role.

entity_forms.definition: A single modelled instance of a non-polymer chemical component, identified by chain and residue number.
entity_forms.inclusion_rule: One row per (comp_id, auth_asym_id, auth_seq_id, insertion_code) instance reported by RCSB nonpolymer_entity_instances.
entity_forms.exclusion_rule: Not used for the entity as a chemical concept; that is nonpolymer_entity.
entity_forms.decision_logic: Emitted whenever instance-level container identifiers are present. Instance identity is what distinguishes two copies of the same compound bound at two different sites.

entity_forms.definition: A non-polymer chemical component as an entity, aggregating all its instances in the entry.
entity_forms.inclusion_rule: One row per RCSB nonpolymer entity id.
entity_forms.exclusion_rule: Never used to represent a specific binding event; a binding event is instance-level.

entity_forms.definition: A complete polymer entity (protein, peptide or nucleic acid) modelled as its own chain.
entity_forms.inclusion_rule: One row per RCSB polymer entity id.
entity_forms.exclusion_rule: Not used when only part of a chain acts as the biological ligand; that is polymer_segment.

entity_forms.definition: A defined residue range within a non-receptor polymer chain that is the interacting ligand.
entity_forms.inclusion_rule: Requires an explicit residue range from a source annotation or the primary publication.
entity_forms.exclusion_rule: May not be produced by geometric proximity alone.
entity_forms.decision_logic: Assigned only where a source states which part of the chain is the ligand. Absent such a statement the form stays polymer_chain and the segment question is recorded as unresolved.

entity_forms.definition: A residue range within the receptor chain itself that acts as a tethered ligand, as in protease-activated receptors.
entity_forms.inclusion_rule: Requires official receptor annotation, a cleavage-site mapping, or a primary-publication statement.
entity_forms.exclusion_rule: Never assigned from proximity, from sequence pattern matching, or from receptor family alone.
entity_forms.decision_logic: Without a citable source the record is emitted with classification_confidence=unresolved and manual_review_status=required, rather than guessed.

entity_forms.definition: An entity covalently bonded to the receptor.
entity_forms.inclusion_rule: RCSB instance annotation HAS_COVALENT_LINKAGE, or an explicit source statement of a covalent bond.
entity_forms.exclusion_rule: HAS_METAL_COORDINATION_LINKAGE is coordination, not a covalent bond, and does not qualify.
entity_forms.decision_logic: Covalency is a bonding fact recorded independently of pharmacology. It never by itself implies agonism or an active state.

entity_forms.definition: The structure carries no entity of this kind.
entity_forms.inclusion_rule: Used at structure level when a positive source statement says no ligand is present.
entity_forms.exclusion_rule: Never inferred from a zero count alone.
entity_forms.decision_logic: Requires positive evidence, e.g. a GPCRdb annotation of 'Apo (no ligand)'.

entity_forms.definition: The form could not be determined from available sources.
entity_forms.inclusion_rule: Default whenever evidence is absent or contradictory.
entity_forms.exclusion_rule: May not be used to hide a determination that the sources actually support.
entity_forms.decision_logic: An honest unresolved is preferred to a confident guess; these records populate the manual review queue.

vocabulary_status.policy: A value outside this file may not appear in any Phase 2 artefact. The test suite fails on an unknown value rather than accepting it. Adding a value requires an entry in governance/DECISION_LOG.md.
